name: baron-vsc
description: Language support for the Baron BBC Micro assembler: syntax highlighting (including inline BBC BASIC), go to definition, completion, hover, outline, references, and build integration.

semanticTokenTypes.description: A 65C02-only mnemonic or addressing mode, in a section with cmos enabled
A 65C02-only mnemonic or addressing mode, outside any cmos section

commands.title: Baron: Set Root Source Files from Active Editor

baron.executablePath.description: Path to the baron executable. A bare name is looked up on PATH.

baron.sourceFiles.description: The root source files passed to baron on the command line, relative to the workspace folder. These also define the include graph used for go-to-definition. If empty, the active editor's file is used.

baron.buildArgs.description: Extra command line switches passed to baron before the source files, e.g. ["-o", "demo.ssd", "--opt", "3", "--title", "DEMO"].

baron.outputFile.description: The output disc image (.ssd), relative to the workspace folder. When set, "-o <outputFile>" is passed to baron automatically (unless baron.buildArgs already contains -o), and "Baron: Run in Emulator" boots this image. Set it with the "Baron: Set Output Disc Image..." command.

baron.emulatorPath.description: Path to the emulator executable launched by "Baron: Run in Emulator". A bare name is looked up on PATH.

baron.emulatorArgs.description: Arguments passed to the emulator. ${image} is replaced by the disc image path (the value of -o in baron.buildArgs); if no argument mentions ${image}, the image path is appended. The default suits b2: boot drive 0 from the image.

baron.buildOverride.description: When set, a shell command that completely replaces the default build invocation (baron + buildArgs + outputFile + sourceFiles) for "Baron: Assemble" and the build step of "Baron: Run in Emulator" - e.g. a build script. Its stderr is still parsed for file:line:col diagnostics. Checks and "Assemble with Switches..." still invoke baron directly.

enumDescriptions: Run baron --check shortly after you stop typing (unsaved edits are checked via a shadow copy) and on save.
Run baron --check only when a file is saved.
Never run checks automatically (the Baron: Check command still works).
baron.check.description: When to run `baron --check` in the background and refresh the Problems panel. A check assembles everything but writes no output files. Requires a baron built with --check support.
